evals.prompt: Create an interactive HTML slide deck explaining the Core Self-Attention mechanism from the Transformer architecture ('Attention Is All You Need'). It must include an interactive canvas where the user can adjust key/query vector alignment using a slider and see the attention scores updated visually.
evals.expected_output: A single self-contained HTML file containing slide navigation, Space Grotesk typography, a dark digital-grid theme, and an interactive canvas simulating self-attention scores.

assertions.name: has_slide_deck_structure
assertions.description: Output contains elements with the class 'slide'.

assertions.name: has_canvas_and_slider
assertions.description: Output contains a canvas and a range input slider.

assertions.name: implements_keyboard_navigation
assertions.description: JavaScript implements keydown navigation for Arrow keys or Space.

evals.prompt: Create an interactive HTML presentation explaining Gradient Descent optimization. It should have a visual canvas showing a 2D loss surface (quadratic curve) and an interactive slider to alter the learning rate (step size), drawing the gradient steps dynamically to show convergence vs divergence.
evals.expected_output: A single self-contained HTML file containing gradient descent slides, interactive controls, and canvas displaying steps down a parabola.

assertions.name: has_slide_deck_structure
assertions.description: Output contains elements with the class 'slide'.

assertions.name: has_canvas_and_slider
assertions.description: Output contains a canvas and a range input slider.

assertions.name: implements_keyboard_navigation
assertions.description: JavaScript implements keydown navigation for Arrow keys or Space.
